concept.title: Engine coolant temperature gauge / Hybrid battery SOC (State of Charge) gauge

section.title: Engine coolant temperature gauge
section.p: This gauge displays the engine coolant temperature when the ENGINE START/STOP button is ON position.

note.p: If the gauge pointer moves beyond the normal range area toward the “H” (Hot) position, it indicates overheating that may damage the engine.
Do not continue driving with an overheated engine. If your vehicle overheats, refer to .
Never remove the radiator cap when the engine is hot. The engine coolant is under pressure and could severely burn you. Wait until the engine is cool before adding coolant to the reservoir.

section.title: Hybrid battery SOC (State of Charge) gauge
section.p: This gauge indicates the remaining hybrid battery power. If the SOC is near the “L (Low)” or “0” level, the vehicle automatically operates the engine to charge the battery.

However, if the Service Indicator () and Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL) () turn on when the SOC gauge is near the “L (Low)” or “0” level, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

note.p: Never try to start the vehicle if the fuel tank is empty. In this condition, the engine cannot charge the high voltage battery of the hybrid system. If you try to start the vehicle when the fuel is empty, the high voltage battery will become discharged and be damaged.
